ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a calendar page covered by a large gray ink stain. At the top, the weekday columns can still be seen in order as Mo, Di, Mi, Do, Fr, Sa, So. The visible number 2 is located under the Do (Thursday) column, and the number 3 is located under the Fr (Friday) column. method.method_draft: 先看图：日历页顶部能看到星期栏是 Mo, Di, Mi, Do, Fr, Sa, So；还能看到数字 2 在 Do 下、3 在 Fr 下，所以 1 必然在 Mi 下，也就是星期三。再算题目问的 25 日：25 比 1 大 24 天，而 24 = 3×7 + 3，所以星期往后顺推 3 天。星期三往后 3 天是星期六。
